# Raise Your Hand Texas

> > Raise Your Hand Texas is a grassroots public education advocacy organization working to improve school funding, assessment reform, and education policy across Texas.

Raise Your Hand Texas mobilizes community advocates and education stakeholders to influence Texas legislative policy on school finance, standardized testing, and public education priorities. The organization operates through fellowship programs, advocacy core teams, and strategic campaigns focused on sustainable funding solutions and accountability reform.

## Core Advocacy & Mission

- [Raise Your Hand Texas - Public Education Advocacy & Policies](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org): Homepage for Raise Your Hand Texas public education advocacy organization
- [How We Advocate for Public Education - Raise Your Hand Texas](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/advancing-public-education): Overview of advocacy methods, fellowship programs, and community organizing
- [What We Are Building - Raise Your Hand Texas](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/policy): Overview of policy priorities and advocacy focus areas for Texas education
- [Get Involved with Raise Your Hand Texas](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/get-involved): Entry point for community engagement and advocacy participation opportunities

## School Funding & Finance Policy

- [Texas Public School Funding | Money for Schools - RYHT](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/policy/school-funding): Texas school funding policy and HB 2 legislative advocacy information
- [Legacy Education Fund - Raise Your Hand Texas](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/policy/school-funding/endowment): Legacy Education Fund endowment proposal for long-term Texas school funding
- [Texas School Finance 101 - Raise Your Hand Texas](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/policy/school-funding/school-finance): Educational guide explaining Texas school finance system and funding mechanisms

## Assessment & Accountability Reform

- [Assessment Accountability - Raise Your Hand Texas](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/policy/assessment-accountability): Assessment accountability reform and STAAR testing policy advocacy
- [Measure What Matters](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/advancing-public-education/our-advocacy-campaigns/measure-what-matters): Measure What Matters campaign for standardized testing reform in Texas
- [Measure What Matters Council | Assessment & Accountability](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/advancing-public-education/our-advocacy-campaigns/measure-what-matters/measure-what-matters-council): Measure What Matters Council members and stakeholder engagement on assessments
- [Measure What Matters | Texas Assessments & Accountability](https://www.raiseyourhandtexas.org/advancing-public-education/our-advocacy-campaigns/measure-what-matters/texas-voices): Community feedback and policy recommendations on Texas assessment systems
